metadata.case_name: BERTA MARGARETE IRMGARD LAWRENCE v. CHINA MOTOR BUS CO LTD AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: part-time teacher at the Goethe Institute

injuries.description: a wedge compression fracture of lumbar 3 vertebra with local tenderness over the fractured vertebral level.
source: she sustained a wedge compression fracture of lumbar 3 vertebra with local tenderness over the fractured vertebral level.

injuries.description: degenerative disc disease in the lumbar spine

manifestations.description: local tenderness over the fractured vertebral level
intermittent back pain especially when under stress
not able to remain upright for more than 4 hours
could move about with 2 sticks; had to use a stick or umbrella for support except when her husband is there to support her
spent most of her time lying down; could not be up for more than 2 hours without lying down otherwise she would suffer unbearable pain
